# fw infer

> Reference of the fw infer command: Send a prompt to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; with --gguf, read the GGUF header and run a Q8_0 dot-product sample (no…

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/infer/

Send a prompt to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; with --gguf, read the GGUF header and run a Q8_0 dot-product sample (no token generation)

## Usage

```bash
fw infer [prompt] [--gguf <path>] [--model <m>] [--url <u>]
```

## Aliases

`fw run` runs `fw infer`.

## Flags

| Flag | Argument |
|---|---|
| `--gguf` | `<path>` |
| `--model` | `<m>` |
| `--url` | `<u>` |

## Global options

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
